evals.prompt: У нас B2B marketplace в виде модульного монолита: PostgreSQL, 18 инженеров, 1200 заказов в минуту на пике, p99 checkout 420 мс при SLO 700 мс, доступность 99.9%. Две команды предлагают сразу выделить catalog, orders, inventory, payments, delivery и notifications в отдельные сервисы с Kafka и отдельной базой на сервис, потому что в следующем году инженеров станет около 30. Реальных проблем независимого масштабирования и релизов пока нет, но checkout должен исключать повторный заказ по idempotency key и не продавать остаток ниже нуля. Спроектируй целевую архитектуру на ближайшие 12 месяцев, сравни с предложением микросервисов и дай критерии, при которых декомпозиция действительно понадобится. Ничего не внедряй.
evals.expected_output: A forces-driven design that starts from the viable modular monolith, quantifies the current envelope, protects checkout invariants, and defines evidence-based extraction seams instead of adopting microservices and Kafka by default.
expectations: Uses the supplied context without re-asking for it, separates facts, assumptions, targets, and open decisions, and keeps the request read-only.
Uses the supplied peak rate and latency/SLO to build a concrete capacity and concurrency envelope rather than inventing scale pressure.
Starts with the simplest viable topology and requires each proposed boundary, datastore, broker, or cache to resolve a named force.
Keeps order idempotency and inventory non-oversell inside explicit authoritative transaction or concurrency boundaries.
Compares the modular design with the proposed microservices alternative across failure, consistency, delivery, operations, and team cost, and gives measurable extraction triggers.
Defines rollout and proof without claiming that implementation, deployment, or production validation occurred.

evals.prompt: Спроектируй ingestion и query-систему для телеметрии устройств. В среднем приходит 180 тысяч событий/с, пик 600 тысяч/с на 20 минут, payload после декодирования 900 байт, один device иногда генерирует в 200 раз больше среднего. Сырые события храним 30 дней, агрегаты 2 года. Потеря подтвержденного события недопустима, дубликаты допустимы только если будут устранены до суточного billing aggregate. Dashboard должен показывать данные не старше 2 минут и отвечать p99 < 1 секунды. Один регион допустимо потерять с RPO 30 секунд и RTO 15 минут. Дай архитектуру, capacity math, partitioning, overload/recovery model и validation plan.
evals.expected_output: A quantitatively feasible ingestion architecture with explicit durability, partitioning, skew, derived-data freshness, regional recovery, backlog drain, and end-to-end proof contracts.
expectations: Calculates at least ingress bandwidth, daily raw volume before replication/overhead, burst volume, retention order of magnitude, and recovery or drain capacity with visible units and assumptions.
Defines message/event identity, durable acceptance, source of truth, deduplication boundary, aggregate rebuild, and the exact meaning of the two-minute freshness target.
Chooses and justifies a partition key while addressing the 200x hot-device skew, rebalancing, and cross-partition aggregation.
Models bounded admission, backpressure, backlog age, retry amplification, degraded behavior, and capacity after a failure domain is lost.
Connects the multi-region data path to the stated RPO/RTO and defines fencing, traffic routing, catch-up, and failback rather than writing 'use active-active'.
Hands detailed messaging, job, cache, schema, or PostgreSQL work to dedicated skills while retaining their cross-component contracts.

evals.prompt: Нужно спроектировать checkout между Order, Inventory и внешним Payment Provider. Общей distributed transaction нет. Клиент может повторять запрос, HTTP timeout не показывает, создал ли provider payment, inventory reservation истекает через 10 минут, webhook provider приходит с дублями и иногда раньше HTTP response. Бизнес требует: не списать деньги дважды, каждый подтвержденный платеж должен привести либо к заказу, либо к видимой оператору reconciliation-задаче; нельзя обещать ровно один вызов. Опиши component interactions, state ownership, consistency, saga/recovery, user-visible states, observability и тесты.
evals.expected_output: A concrete checkout process with durable operation identity, explicit local commits and pending states, bounded provider and inventory contracts, recovery and reconciliation, and no false exactly-once or rollback claims.
expectations: Defines one checkout/payment intent identity reused across client retries, provider calls, callbacks, state transitions, and reconciliation.
Names authoritative state and durable commit points for order, reservation, payment knowledge, and workflow progress.
Treats timeout and webhook/response reordering as ambiguous distributed outcomes and specifies idempotent handling and reconciliation.
Uses saga or forward recovery with explicit irreversible effects, expiration races, terminal/manual states, and user-visible pending behavior rather than claiming transactional rollback.
Provides a failure matrix and executable crash, duplicate, reorder, expiry, lost-response, and replay tests.
When mechanism-level follow-up is required, names external-api-integration or reliable-messaging together with the unresolved provider or delivery question, without losing the end-to-end invariant.

evals.prompt: Проектируем multi-tenant document service для клиентов в ЕС и США. Данные клиентов ЕС не могут храниться в США. 80% операций — чтения, p95 < 150 мс внутри домашнего региона, availability 99.99%, RPO 0 для подтвержденных изменений документа и RTO 10 минут при потере региона. Команда предлагает global active-active database и routing в ближайший регион для всех запросов. Документ редактирует один пользователь за раз, но фоновые индексаторы и antivirus workers работают асинхронно. Разбери предложение и дай более точный multi-region design, failover/failback и disaster-recovery proof.
evals.expected_output: A residency-aware multi-region design that tests whether global active-active is earned, separates tenant placement and data authority from derived asynchronous work, and makes the RPO/RTO and regional-loss proof concrete.
expectations: Identifies the conflict between nearest-region global routing and EU residency and assigns tenants or data to explicit regional authorities.
Challenges active-active using the single-writer document semantics and compares it with a simpler home-region, cell/stamp, or active-passive alternative.
Defines confirmed-write semantics, synchronous durability scope, surviving capacity, routing, fencing, dependency independence, and behavior during isolation.
Separates authoritative documents from rebuildable indexes, scans, caches, and worker state and assigns freshness and recovery contracts.
Defines a tested restore/failover/failback path that can establish RPO 0 and RTO 10 minutes, including integrity and split-brain checks.
Labels assumptions and unverified provider capabilities instead of presenting a cloud product name as proof.

evals.prompt: Сделай read-only review архитектуры нового customer-notification сервиса. В диаграмме: API Gateway -> Kafka -> Router Service -> Email Service, SMS Service и Push Service; у каждого своя PostgreSQL, перед Router стоит Redis, все сервисы ретраят вызовы по 5 раз. Требования пока только 'масштабируемо и надежно'. Не указаны объем, SLO, owner данных, message identity, ordering, TTL уведомления, provider limits, DLQ/replay, tenant isolation, rollout или recovery. Команда уже называет дизайн production-ready. Дай verdict, самые опасные пробелы, минимальный design baseline и evidence plan. Ничего не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A not-ready architecture review that exposes missing forces and contracts, avoids rubber-stamping named technologies, proposes the simplest defensible baseline, and defines the evidence required for production readiness.
expectations: Leads with a clear not-ready verdict, ranks the decision-changing gaps, names the exact next evidence or action, and keeps the review read-only.
Distinguishes facts from unknowns and asks for or parameterizes load, latency, availability, expiry, tenant, and provider constraints without fabricating numbers.
Identifies ownerless notification intent/status, message identity, commit and acknowledgement boundaries, ordering, retry multiplication, provider ambiguity, and reconciliation gaps.
Evaluates whether Kafka, Redis, four services, and separate databases each resolve a named force and offers a simpler viable topology for the current evidence.
Provides a failure/overload matrix and bounded load, duplicate, replay, provider-timeout, backlog, isolation, deployment, and recovery proof plan.
Names the matching capability skill and unresolved mechanism question for each required deep dive while preserving one end-to-end notification contract.

evals.prompt: Сделай узкий read-only diagnosis одного контракта. API Service вызывает Pricing Service с deadline 800 ms. Оба слоя независимо делают до 3 попыток по 500 ms, поэтому при деградации возникает до 9 downstream calls и запрос выходит за общий deadline. Остальная архитектура и capacity сейчас не обсуждаются. Укажи точную причину, минимальный target contract и проверку; ничего не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A compact causal diagnosis of multiplicative nested retries that assigns one retry owner, propagates the remaining deadline, bounds attempts and backoff, and gives a focused falsifier without reopening unrelated topology or capacity design.
expectations: Identifies independent nested retry loops as the direct amplification cause and explains why their per-attempt timeouts cannot fit the 800 ms end-to-end budget.
Assigns one deliberate retry owner, propagates remaining deadline and cancellation, and bounds per-attempt timeout, attempts, backoff, and concurrency.
Conditions retries on safe operation identity or idempotency and transient failure classification rather than retrying every failure.
Provides a runnable degraded-dependency test that bounds total downstream calls and wall-clock completion within the declared contract.
Keeps the answer read-only and scoped to the affected edge without inventing unrelated services, stores, capacity math, migrations, or a full architecture report.

evals.prompt: Внутренний сервис раз в день импортирует CSV до 20 тысяч строк. Один процесс и один PostgreSQL укладываются в 40 секунд при допустимом окне 10 минут; повторный запуск можно сделать идемпотентным по file_hash. Команда предлагает Kafka, отдельный coordinator и четыре workers 'для масштабируемости'. Выбери архитектуру на текущие требования, зафиксируй гарантию и критерии, когда усложнение станет оправданным. Production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A simple single-deployable, single-database import design with stable file identity and transactional or checkpointed application, plus measurable triggers for later parallelism, without speculative Kafka or coordinator infrastructure.
expectations: Keeps one deployable and PostgreSQL because the supplied 40-second runtime already fits the 10-minute window and no independent scaling or failure boundary is established.
Uses file_hash as a stable import identity with a durable status/result and defines whether row application is transactional or safely checkpointed and replayable.
Defines the caller/operator-visible accepted, running, succeeded, and failed behavior without claiming exactly-once execution.
Names measurable upgrade triggers such as sustained window breach, resource saturation, required parallel tenant isolation, or independent fan-out rather than future-proofing by assertion.
Provides a compact rollback/crash/duplicate-file proof and does not add Kafka, coordinator, or worker topology without a named force.

evals.prompt: Спроектируй read-only migration существующего checkout: сейчас Orders и Billing живут в одном монолите и одной PostgreSQL-транзакции. Нужно вынести Billing в отдельный сервис со своей БД без простоя. Уже есть at-least-once broker. Старые и новые версии будут сосуществовать до двух недель. Подтвержденный заказ не должен потерять billing intent. До cutover нужен безопасный rollback; после того как новый Billing начал писать состояние, которое старый код не понимает, нужен явный roll-forward boundary. Пик 2 000 orders/s, остальные размеры неизвестны. Дай target contracts, этапы migration/cutover, rollback или roll-forward, failure behavior и proof. Production не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A zero-downtime extraction plan with one durable confirmed-order-to-billing-intent commit path, mixed-version compatibility, explicit authority and irreversible boundary, owned cleanup, variable capacity math, ambiguous-outcome recovery, and executable cutover evidence.
expectations: Defines the confirmed-order invariant, stable billing identity, authoritative state, and durable commit path without a non-atomic dual write between databases and the broker.
Provides an expand-compatible mixed-version migration with deployment order, bounded backfill or reconciliation, shadow comparison, and objective cutover criteria.
Assigns an owner and removal condition to temporary writers, adapters, flags, shadow state, jobs, and legacy compatibility paths.
Names the last rollback-safe state, the first new-only or irreversible write, who may cross it, and the roll-forward or repair path after it.
Uses the known 2,000 orders/s peak while preserving payload, fan-out, retention, retry amplification, and sustainable service rate as independent variables for backlog and drain evidence.
Covers a lost response after each authoritative commit, same-identity retry, duplicate or delayed delivery, broker or Billing outage, replay, abort signals, and user-visible recovery behavior.
Keeps the design read-only, names any required mechanism-specific skill and unresolved question, and distinguishes proposed proof from deployed or live evidence.
